plan.title: Live RFQ Counter Offer to Vendor A

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses tab containing Vendor A's 100 bid and Vendor B's 90 bid.
Ensure counter offers are enabled on RFQ rounds.
Ensure the prepared RFQ project flow is enabled for the tenant.
Send the buyer's counter offer on Vendor A's normal bid with the requested price and remark.
Verify Vendor A's bid is marked as having a counter offer initiated.
Verify the sent offer exposes the Revoke Counter Offer action.
Verify the original Counter Offer action is replaced after sending.
Open the live RFQ Participants panel to inspect the counter-offer status.
Verify the participants panel counts the sent offer as an active counter offer.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal to verify the recipient-facing offer.
Open the prepared event overview in Vendor A's portal.
Verify Vendor A can accept the received counter offer.
Verify the vendor portal visibly identifies the pending counter offer.
